card.name: The word of after a noun
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after a noun such as signs, proportion, healing, functioning, formulations or grades. It links that noun to a following noun phrase, in both medical and general text.

modes.label: Of after a noun
modes.description: "of" follows an abstract or measure noun and introduces what it refers to.
modes.example: showed signs<< of>> aggression, such as biting or kicking,

modes.label: Of after a superlative or title noun
modes.description: "of" follows a word like worst or faces in a general phrase.
modes.example: Perhaps worst<< of>> all, toilets stopped functioning. And passengers
